key.name: start-at-login
key.description: Start Lookout hidden when you log in, so mail and calendar notifications keep working without a window.

key.name: close-to-background
key.summary: Keep running when the window is closed
key.description: Continue syncing and showing mail and calendar notifications after the window is closed; quit from the File menu.

key.name: animate-transitions
key.description: Fade between views when switching messages.

key.name: background-wallpaper-enabled
key.description: Whether the window shows a wallpaper (bundled artwork or a user-picked image) behind the app content; when off, the window background image, dimming and restore options are unavailable.

key.name: window-background-path
key.description: Path to a user-picked image used as the window background; empty means the bundled artwork.

key.name: background-brightness
key.description: How bright the window background is shown - the bundled artwork as well as a user-picked image: 1.0 means no darkening, 0.0 means darkened to black.

key.name: theme-id
key.description: The bundled flat-token theme: 'system' follows the system light/dark scheme, 'flat-dark' and 'flat-light' pin the app's surfaces to one scheme.

key.name: accent-color
key.description: A CSS colour string (as written by gdk::RGBA::to_str) used app-wide instead of the system accent; empty means follow the system accent.

key.name: ribbon-style
key.description: How the command ribbon lays its actions out: 'simplified' is one row with the label beside each icon, 'classic' stacks the icon over the label and captions each group.

key.name: ribbon-collapsed
key.description: Whether the command ribbon is collapsed to just its tab strip (Ctrl+F1 toggles it), as in Outlook's classic ribbon.

key.name: layout-reading-pane-position
key.description: Where the reading pane sits: right (beside the message list) or bottom (below it). The layout-reading-pane boolean stays the on/off switch, so "off" is that boolean being false regardless of this value.

key.name: layout-vertical-spacing
key.summary: Density of the folder and message list panes
key.description: How much vertical space each row takes in the folder and message list panes, shown with Outlook's density names: Full (the most padding), Medium (the default) or Compact (the least). The stored values remain "loose", "medium" and "tight" so an existing setting keeps working.

key.name: layout-message-preview-lines
key.summary: Message preview lines in the message list
key.description: How many lines of the message body preview to show on each list row: 0 hides the preview entirely. 1 is the default, matching Outlook.

key.name: pane-folder-width-percent
key.summary: Folder pane width as a percentage of the window width
key.description: Last width the folder pane was dragged to, as a percentage of the application window width; -1 means never set. Reapplied when the window is resized.

key.name: pane-message-list-width-percent
key.summary: Message list pane width as a percentage of the window width
key.description: Last width the message list pane was dragged to, as a percentage of the application window width; -1 means never set. Reapplied when the window is resized.

key.name: pane-message-list-height-percent
key.summary: Message list pane height as a percentage of the window height
key.description: Last height the message list pane was dragged to while the reading pane is at the bottom, as a percentage of the application window height; -1 means never set. Reapplied when the window is resized.

key.name: pane-calendar-sidebar-width-percent
key.summary: Calendar sidebar pane width as a percentage of the window width
key.description: Last width the calendar sidebar pane was dragged to, as a percentage of the application window width; -1 means never set. Reapplied when the window is resized.

key.name: pane-contacts-sidebar-width-percent
key.summary: Contacts sidebar pane width as a percentage of the window width
key.description: Last width the contacts sidebar pane was dragged to, as a percentage of the application window width; -1 means never set. Reapplied when the window is resized.

key.name: pane-contacts-details-width-percent
key.summary: Contacts details pane width as a percentage of the window width
key.description: Last width the contacts details pane (UX-65) was dragged to, as a percentage of the application window width; -1 means never set. Reapplied when the window is resized.

key.name: pane-config-sidebar-width-percent
key.summary: Config sidebar pane width as a percentage of the window width
key.description: Last width the Config sidebar pane was dragged to, as a percentage of the application window width; -1 means never set. Reapplied when the window is resized.

key.name: pane-mail-overview-width-percent
key.summary: Mail overview pane width as a percentage of the window width
key.description: Last width the mail-tab mini-calendar overview pane was dragged to, as a percentage of the application window width; -1 means never set. Reapplied when the window is resized.

key.name: window-width
key.description: Last non-maximized width of the main window in pixels. Restored at startup.

key.name: window-height
key.description: Last non-maximized height of the main window in pixels. Restored at startup.

key.name: window-maximized
key.description: Whether the main window was maximized when last closed. Restored at startup.

key.name: mail-favorites
key.description: MailboxIds of folders pinned to the top of the folder tree.

key.name: mail-favorites-custom-order
key.description: Set once a favorite folder is moved up or down: the Favorites section then follows the order of mail-favorites instead of sorting alphabetically.

key.name: accounts-disabled
key.description: AccountIds of GOA accounts whose mail, calendars, tasks and contacts Lookout must not process; everything else is enabled by default.

key.name: mail-threaded
key.description: Show replies as collapsible conversation threads in the message list instead of bare messages.

key.name: mail-conversation-order
key.description: Order of the stacked messages when the reading pane shows a whole conversation: newest-top (Outlook's default) or newest-bottom.

key.name: mail-conversation-include-sent
key.description: Show your own replies from Sent Items among a conversation's messages in the reading pane (Outlook's "Show messages from other folders").

key.name: mail-filters
key.description: The independent filters narrowing the message list (unread, flagged, has-attachments, high-importance, categorized, to-me). Empty shows every message.

key.name: mail-search-scope
key.description: Which folders a search sweeps: folder, subfolders, account or all mailboxes.

key.name: mail-load-remote-images
key.description: Allow the reading pane to load image resources from remote servers.

key.name: mail-rich-text-default
key.summary: Start new messages in the formatted editor

key.name: mail-spell-check
key.description: Turn on WebKit's spellchecking in the composer, underlining misspelled words.

key.name: mail-spell-check-languages
key.description: WebKit language tags (e.g. "en_US") to check spelling in. Empty means the system locale's language.

key.name: mail-show-sender-images
key.description: Show a sender avatar on each message-list row and in the reading-pane header: the contact's photo when their address book card has one, otherwise coloured initials.

key.name: mail-message-theme-dark
key.summary: Open HTML messages in dark mode
key.description: When on, newly-opened HTML messages show with their own background removed and colours inverted instead of in their original light form. The reading pane's per-message "Switch message theme" toggle overrides this for the current message either way.

key.name: mail-send-read-receipts
key.description: When a message asks for a read receipt (a Disposition-Notification-To header), reply with one automatically on display. When off, the reading pane asks first.

key.name: mark-as-read-mode
key.summary: When to mark a message as read
key.description: When opening a message marks it read: 'when-opened' marks it as soon as the reading pane shows it, 'on-selection-change' when the selection moves away from it (the default, matching Outlook), 'after-delay' after the configured number of seconds, and 'never' leaves it unread until marked by hand.

key.name: mark-as-read-delay
key.description: Seconds a message must stay on screen before it is marked read when the mark-as-read mode is 'after-delay'.

key.name: mail-undo-send-seconds
key.description: Seconds a sent message waits in the outbox before it goes out, during which the "Sending" notification offers Undo. 0 sends immediately with no Undo.

key.name: mail-warn-no-attachment
key.summary: Warn if a message looks like it is missing an attachment
key.description: Before sending, look for words like "attached" or "enclosure" in the subject and body; if the message has no attachments, ask whether to send it anyway.

key.name: mail-internal-domains
key.description: Domains belonging to your organisation. The reading pane tags a sender whose address is outside this list as external. Empty disables the tag.

key.name: mail-report-phishing-address
key.description: Where "Report phishing" forwards a message as an attachment before moving it to Junk. Empty hides the Report phishing action.

key.name: mail-notifications-enabled
key.description: Show a desktop notification when new mail arrives or a send fails.

key.name: mail-rules-enabled
key.description: Master switch for the rules engine. Off pauses every rule (client- and server-side) without deleting it.

key.name: dock-badge-enabled
key.description: Show the total unread count on the app icon in the dock (Ubuntu's Unity LauncherEntry badge).

key.name: tray-icon-enabled
key.description: Show an icon in the notification area (the StatusNotifierItem/AppIndicator protocol) with the unread mail count. Clicking it shows or hides the window.

key.name: calendar-alerts-enabled
key.description: Show a notification when an event reminder comes due.

key.name: calendar-search-scope
key.description: Which calendars event search covers: all connected calendars, or only those checked in the sidebar.

key.name: calendar-week-start
key.description: First day of the week for the calendar grids and mini-calendar, as 0=Sunday .. 6=Saturday.

key.name: calendar-work-days
key.description: Weekdays shown in the Work week view, as day numbers 0=Sunday .. 6=Saturday.

key.name: calendar-work-start
key.description: Local hour the business-hours band begins in the day/week grids.

key.name: calendar-work-end
key.description: Local hour the business-hours band ends (exclusive) in the day/week grids.

key.name: calendar-primary-tz
key.description: IANA name of the calendar's primary time zone; empty means the system local zone.

key.name: calendar-secondary-tz
key.description: IANA name of an optional second time zone shown in the grid's gutter; empty means none.

key.name: calendar-default-reminder
key.description: Minutes before a new event its reminder defaults to; -1 means no default reminder.

key.name: eds-mirror-calendar
key.summary: Show Lookout events in the GNOME clock and calendar
key.description: Copy Lookout's events into the desktop's calendar store (Evolution Data Server) as a read-only calendar, so GNOME Shell's clock and GNOME Calendar show them. Other apps on the desktop can read the copied titles, times and locations. Has no effect when Evolution Data Server isn't available.

key.name: eds-mirror-details
key.summary: Include event notes in the mirror
key.description: Also copy event descriptions into the desktop calendar mirror. Notes routinely hold dial-in codes, agendas and other private text, which every app on the desktop can read, so this is off by default.

key.name: contacts-file-as
key.description: How a contact with no per-contact "File as" value is listed and sorted in the People screen: last-first ("Doe, Jane", Outlook's default), first-last ("Jane Doe") or company (the organisation name).

key.name: eds-address-books
key.description: Also suggest people from the desktop's own address books (GNOME Contacts and Evolution, through Evolution Data Server) in recipient autocomplete, the contact picker and People search, and list those books read-only in the People screen's Desktop section. Books belonging to an online account whose contacts Lookout already syncs are skipped. Has no effect when Evolution Data Server isn't available.

key.name: tasks-sort-key
key.description: How tasks are ordered within their group in the Tasks view: due date, importance, title or creation date.

key.name: tasks-group-by
key.description: How tasks are grouped into sections: by due-date bucket (Overdue/Today/This week/Later/Completed, the default), by task list, by category, or ungrouped.

key.name: tasks-show-completed
key.description: Whether completed tasks are shown in the Tasks view.

key.name: assistant-api-url
key.description: Base URL of the OpenAI-compatible API the assistant talks to, e.g. https://api.openai.com/v1. The API token itself lives in the GNOME keyring, never in dconf.

key.name: assistant-agent
key.description: The model id chosen from the API's /models list; empty means none selected yet.

key.name: shortcuts
key.description: One 'action=accelerator' entry per action overriding the built-in default, e.g. 'compose=<Primary>n'. An empty array means all built-in defaults.

key.name: prefetch-aggressive
key.description: When on, the background body prefetch runs more eagerly: batches fire on a short timer instead of waiting for activity, more of each folder is warmed, and the whole pass re-scans periodically. Uses more bandwidth and server connections.

key.name: prefetch-batch-interval-seconds
key.description: How often the background body prefetch runs a batch while aggressive prefetch is enabled. Lower values download bodies faster but use more bandwidth.

key.name: prefetch-folder-limit
key.description: How many of the newest messages in each folder get their bodies downloaded during aggressive prefetch; older messages still fetch on demand.

key.name: prefetch-batch-size
key.description: How many message bodies each prefetch round trip downloads. Larger batches download faster but each one is a round trip a user command can queue behind.

key.name: prefetch-refresh-interval-minutes
key.description: How often the aggressive prefetch re-scans every folder, so mail that arrived in unopened folders gets its bodies cached too.

key.name: privacy-blur-mode
key.description: How much text the privacy blur hides for screenshots: 'off' blurs nothing, 'sensitive' blurs email addresses, account names and people's names, 'all' blurs content text including message bodies while leaving app chrome such as buttons, menus and headings readable. Intended for taking screenshots for demos and marketing, so personal details are not readable.

key.name: last-view-unified
key.summary: Folder pane was on the unified view

key.name: last-view-mailbox
key.description: The MailboxId of the folder the pane reopened on; empty means none.
